claims.statement: Management states the aspiration to add stores growing at roughly 15% to 20% CAGR.
claims.quote: The theme is the same, 15%, 20%. Okay? You replace everything that I said, 15% with 20% even for this year, right? That's the aspiration.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management mentions plans to open stores in Uttar Pradesh and Orissa.
claims.quote: But that apart, we do see opportunities of going to Orissa, going to Uttar Pradesh (UP) and you will see some stores coming up in UP. We have already tied up a few firm deals in these states.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states that pharmacy sections within stores take around 300 to 800 square feet.
claims.quote: I think pharmacy takes around 600, 800, or sometimes even 300 square feet. So, a very small space.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: Distribution centres have increased from 49 to 62.
facts.quote: distribution centres have increased from 49 to 62.

facts.statement: MMR operations for DMart Ready have not broken even at a PBT level.
New state expansion follows a strategy of supplying from existing distribution centres first before building new ones once critical mass is reached.
facts.quote: Whenever you go to a new state, we don't pre-empt investment through distribution centres in that state first. We, in fact, supply them from the existing distribution centres, which we feel is more prudent. Only once we get critical mass, we build distribution centres.
